title: DesignRule
description: One reusable, engine-facing design principle for Roavvy apparel. A rule is not a note: it states a testable claim, explains the mechanism, and binds to the design genome (design_recipe.schema.json genes) and/or the scoring engine (analytic/pixel scorers) so it can bias generation and inform evaluation. Development-only; never bundled.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. 'R-COMP-01' (topic prefix + number). Referenced by recipes, scorers, critiques and mood boards.

statement.description: One-line, imperative, testable rule. e.g. 'Prefer one dominant element over many small disconnected ones.'

explanation.description: WHY it works — the perceptual, production, or commercial mechanism. Not just an assertion.

confidence.description: How strongly the research + references support this. High = near-universal; low = context-dependent / hypothesis to validate against references + telemetry.

polarity.description: Whether the rule pushes designs toward (prefer), away from (avoid), or gates on context (conditional).

examples.description: Described patterns (NEVER copies of copyrighted artwork) that exemplify the rule; may reference design_studio reference images by stem.

appliesWhen.description: Contexts/scopes where the rule is in force. Prefer DesignContext scope tokens where possible.

exceptions.description: Where the rule does NOT hold, or reverses. Every strong rule has an edge.

genes.description: Which DesignRecipe genes this rule biases, and how. Ties the principle to the searchable parameter space.

direction.description: How the rule biases the gene, e.g. 'favour sparse|balanced', 'penalise dense when |countryCodes|<=3', 'prefer duotone|monochrome', 'avoid grunge+halftone stacked'.

scorers.description: Which scoring signals encode this rule. Use existing scorer names so rules map to weights.

references.description: Supporting evidence: research_summary file, reference image stems (liked/disliked), or external principle sources.

validation.description: How to confirm/refute this rule empirically once telemetry + reference scoring exist.

signal.description: e.g. 'liked references satisfy this at higher rate than disliked', 'chosen designs skew toward this gene value'.
